title: Buttons
content: ButtonsButtons allow users to take actions, and make choices, with a single tap.Common ButtonsFilled Button (Primary)The filled button is the primary button for the most important action.&lt;button class="btn btn-primary"&gt;Primary&lt;/button&gt;PrimaryOutlined ButtonOutlined buttons are medium-emphasis buttons. They contain actions that are important but aren’t the primary action in an app.&lt;button class="btn btn-outlined"&gt;Outlined&lt;/button&gt;OutlinedTonal ButtonTonal buttons are an alternative middle ground between filled and outlined buttons. They’re useful in contexts where a lower-priority button requires slightly more emphasis than an outline would give.&lt;button class="btn btn-tonal"&gt;Tonal&lt;/button&gt;TonalElevated ButtonElevated buttons are essentially filled tonal buttons with a shadow. They prevent separation issues on surfaces that have the same color as the button.&lt;button class="btn btn-elevated"&gt;Elevated&lt;/button&gt;ElevatedText ButtonText buttons are used for low-emphasis actions.&lt;button class="btn btn-text"&gt;Text Button&lt;/button&gt;Text ButtonFloating Action Buttons (FAB)FABs represent the primary action of a screen.Standard FAB&lt;button class="fab"&gt;+&lt;/button&gt;+Small FAB&lt;button class="fab fab-small"&gt;+&lt;/button&gt;+Large FAB&lt;button class="fab fab-large"&gt;+&lt;/button&gt;+Extended FABExtended FABs are wider and include a text label.&lt;button class="fab-extended"&gt;  &lt;span&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;  &lt;span&gt;Create&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/button&gt;  +  CreateIcon ButtonsIcon buttons help people take minor actions with one tap.&lt;!-- Standard --&gt;&lt;button class="icon-btn"&gt;★&lt;/button&gt;&lt;!-- Filled --&gt;&lt;button class="icon-btn filled"&gt;★&lt;/button&gt;&lt;!-- Tonal --&gt;&lt;button class="icon-btn tonal"&gt;★&lt;/button&gt;&lt;!-- Outlined --&gt;&lt;button class="icon-btn outlined"&gt;★&lt;/button&gt;★★★★Segmented ButtonsSegmented buttons help people select options, switch views, or sort elements.&lt;div class="segmented-btn-group"&gt;  &lt;button class="segmented-btn selected"&gt;Day&lt;/button&gt;  &lt;button class="segmented-btn"&gt;Week&lt;/button&gt;  &lt;button class="segmented-btn"&gt;Month&lt;/button&gt;&lt;/div&gt;  Day  Week  Month

title: Configuration
content: Configuration  Color Palettes  Materialistic Jekyll Theme comes with 50 pre-generated color palettes. You can set the global palette in _config.yml:  theme_settings:  palette: "palette-1"    Or override it per page:  ---palette: "palette-10"---  NavigationThe sidebar navigation is automatically generated based on the pages in your project.

 &lt;li class="list-item"&gt;    &lt;span class="leading-element avatar"&gt;A&lt;/span&gt;    &lt;div class="list-item-content"&gt;      &lt;span class="list-item-headline"&gt;Headline&lt;/span&gt;      &lt;span class="list-item-supporting-text"&gt;Supporting text&lt;/span&gt;    &lt;/div&gt;    &lt;span class="trailing-element"&gt;10m&lt;/span&gt;  &lt;/li&gt;  &lt;li class="list-item divider"&gt;&lt;/li&gt;  &lt;li class="list-item"&gt;    &lt;span class="leading-element avatar"&gt;B&lt;/span&gt;    &lt;span class="trailing-element"&gt;5m&lt;/span&gt;  &lt;/li&gt;&lt;/ul&gt;      A          Headline      Supporting text        10m          B          Headline 2      Supporting text 2        5m  ChipsChips help people enter information, make selections, filter content, or trigger actions.Assist{: .chip }Filter{: .chip .filled }Input{: .chip .elevated }AssistFilterInputBadgesBadges show notifications, counts, or status information on other components.&lt;span class="badge"&gt;3&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class="badge small"&gt;&lt;/span&gt;3TooltipsTooltips display informative text when users hover over, focus on, or tap an element.&lt;span class="tooltip" data-tooltip="This is a tooltip"&gt;Hover me&lt;/span&gt;Hover meProgress IndicatorsProgress indicators express an unspecified wait time or display the length of a process.Linear Progress&lt;div class="progress-linear"&gt;&lt;/div&gt;Circular Progress&lt;div class="progress-circular"&gt;&lt;/div&gt;SnackbarsSnackbars provide brief messages about app processes at the bottom of the screen.&lt;div class="snackbar" style="position: static; title: Getting Started
content: Getting Started  Installation  This theme is designed to be used as a template.      Fork the repository or click the “Use this template” button on GitHub.    Clone your new repository locally.    Run bundle install to install dependencies.  UsageCreate your markdown files and specify the layout in the front matter.---layout: doctitle: My Documentation---  Running Locally  bundle exec jekyll serve

title: High-Level Features
content: High-Level FeaturesThis theme is packed with features to make your documentation stand out.  Material Design 3: Fully compliant with the latest Material Design specifications (Material You).  Structured Documentation: Use the docs/ directory for your content.  Nested Navigation: Define a hierarchical sidebar in _data/navigation.yml.  Search: Built-in client-side search.  Color Palettes: 50 pre-made color palettes.  Responsive: Optimized for mobile, tablet, and desktop.Components DemoDemo Button  This is a feature showcase using a filled card component.

title: Components Overview
content: Material 3 ComponentsThe Materialistic Jekyll Theme provides a comprehensive implementation of Material Design 3 components. These components are designed to be used directly in your Markdown files or HTML layouts.UsageMost components are implemented as CSS classes. You can use them by:  HTML Syntax: Directly writing HTML tags with the appropriate classes.    &lt;button class="btn btn-primary"&gt;Click Me&lt;/button&gt;        Kramdown Attribute Lists: Applying classes to Markdown elements (where supported).    **Primary Button**{: .btn .btn-primary }      CategoriesThe components are organized into the following categories:  Buttons: Common actions and triggers (Buttons, FABs, Icon Buttons).  Inputs &amp; Controls: Form inputs and selection controls (Text Fields, Checkboxes, Switches).  Content &amp; Display: Layout and data display (Cards, Lists, Chips, Tables).  Layout &amp; Navigation: Structural and navigational elements (Tabs, Dialogs, Menus).

title: Inputs & Controls
content: Inputs &amp; ControlsInputs enable users to enter information and make selections.Text FieldsText fields let users enter text into a UI.Filled Text FieldFilled text fields have more visual emphasis than outlined text fields, making them stand out when surrounded by other content and components.&lt;div class="text-field"&gt;  &lt;input type="text" placeholder="Label"&gt;&lt;/div&gt;  Outlined Text FieldOutlined text fields have less visual emphasis than filled text fields.&lt;div class="text-field outlined"&gt;  &lt;input type="text" placeholder="Label"&gt;&lt;/div&gt;  Selection ControlsCheckboxCheckboxes let users select one or more items from a list, or turn an option on or off.&lt;label class="checkbox-wrapper"&gt;  &lt;input type="checkbox" checked&gt;  &lt;span&gt;Checked&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/label&gt;&lt;label class="checkbox-wrapper"&gt;  &lt;input type="checkbox"&gt;  &lt;span&gt;Unchecked&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/label&gt;    Checked    UncheckedRadio ButtonRadio buttons let users select one option from a set.&lt;label class="radio-wrapper"&gt;  &lt;input type="radio" name="demo-radio" checked&gt;  &lt;span&gt;Option 1&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/label&gt;&lt;label class="radio-wrapper"&gt;  &lt;input type="radio" name="demo-radio"&gt;  &lt;span&gt;Option 2&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/label&gt;    Option 1    Option 2SwitchSwitches toggle the state of a single setting on or off.&lt;label class="switch"&gt;  &lt;input type="checkbox" checked&gt;  &lt;span class="slider-track"&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/label&gt;&lt;label class="switch"&gt;  &lt;input type="checkbox"&gt;  &lt;span class="slider-track"&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/label&gt;        SlidersSliders allow users to make selections from a range of values.&lt;div class="slider"&gt;  &lt;input type="range" min="0" max="100" value="50"&gt;&lt;/div&gt;

title: Layout & Navigation
content: Layout &amp; NavigationComponents that help structure the page and navigate between different sections.TabsTabs organize content across different screens, data sets, and other interactions.&lt;div class="tabs"&gt;  &lt;div class="tab-item active"&gt;Tab 1&lt;/div&gt;  &lt;div class="tab-item"&gt;Tab 2&lt;/div&gt;  &lt;div class="tab-item"&gt;Tab 3&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;  Tab 1  Tab 2  Tab 3Navigation RailThe navigation rail provides ergonomic movement between primary destinations in apps.&lt;div class="nav-rail" style="height: 300px; display:inline-flex;"&gt;  &lt;div class="nav-rail-item active"&gt;    &lt;span class="icon"&gt;●&lt;/span&gt;    &lt;span class="label"&gt;One&lt;/span&gt;  &lt;/div&gt;  &lt;div class="nav-rail-item"&gt;    &lt;span class="icon"&gt;○&lt;/span&gt;    &lt;span class="label"&gt;Two&lt;/span&gt;  &lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;      ●    One        ○    Two  Bottom SheetsBottom sheets display supplementary content and actions on mobile devices.&lt;div class="bottom-sheet" style="position:relative; transform:none; left:auto; bottom:auto;"&gt;  &lt;div class="drag-handle"&gt;&lt;/div&gt;  &lt;div class="sheet-content"&gt;    &lt;p&gt;Bottom sheet content goes here.&lt;/p&gt;  &lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;        Bottom sheet content goes here.  DialogsDialogs provide important prompts in a user flow.&lt;div class="dialog" style="position: static; transform: none; box-shadow: var(--md-sys-elevation-level-3); margin: 0 auto;"&gt;  &lt;div class="dialog-headline"&gt;Dialog Title&lt;/div&gt;  &lt;div class="dialog-content"&gt;    This is a basic dialog example showing the structure.  &lt;/div&gt;  &lt;div class="dialog-actions"&gt;    &lt;button class="btn btn-text"&gt;Cancel&lt;/button&gt;    &lt;button class="btn btn-text"&gt;OK&lt;/button&gt;  &lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;  Dialog Title      This is a basic dialog example showing the structure.        Cancel    OK  MenusMenus display a list of choices on a temporary surface.&lt;div class="menu"&gt;  &lt;div class="menu-item"&gt;Item 1&lt;/div&gt;  &lt;div class="menu-item"&gt;Item 2&lt;/div&gt;  &lt;div class="menu-item"&gt;Item 3&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;  Item 1  Item 2  Item 3DividersDividers distinguish between sections of content.&lt;hr class="divider"&gt;
